Seth M: follow-up from last night's postmortem re: alert churning on the cache tier. short plan: small changes, owners, and a recurring verification.
Ally P: yep. want to avoid blind silences. incremental only.
Seth M: three concrete items: 1) threshold re-eval for top noisy keys, 2) per-service dedupe with signature and short suppression, 3) add maintenance-aware suppression windows.
Ally P: i'll take thresholds. will run 45-day p95/p99 and propose cutoffs + expected page reduction within 24h.
Seth M: i'll own dedupe impl. plan: 3m collapse + 15m suppression for identical signature. signature = "{{service}}:{{key_pattern}}:{{cmd}}". config in alerts/cache/.
DevOps Bot: (automated) Incident#4771 closed by seth.m  follow-up task 'cache-alert-stabilize' created
Seth M: owners & dates: Ally - thresholds PR due 2024-10-12; Seth - dedupe PR + staging tests due 2024-10-13; both - add runbook snippet and label tuned alerts with "tuned-oct2024".
remediation-tracker: (automated) Task created: cache-alert-stabilize assigned to [Seth M, Ally P] due 2024-10-13
Ally P: will include FN risk note and dashboards in PR. also propose a banner in Slack notifs for 2 weeks.
Seth M: good. i'll exclude suppression during deploy-tagged windows and add whitelist for deploy tags.
Ally P: ack and will post PR link here.
Seth M: ack. i'll post staging logs and brief canary plan when ready.
Seth M: final ask: reply 'ack' once tasks are on the board so I can move them to In Progress.
Ally P: ack
